description.fun: Karrablast has a strange bond with Shelmet: for some reason it evolves when it receives electrical energy while in the same place as one. It also hunts Shelmet, spitting a liquid that melts through their shells so it can eat what's inside. Atsuko Nishida first suggested it as a snail-eating beetle, and its horn looks a bit like an escargot fork. When threatened, it spits acid to drive attackers off.
description.guide: Karrablast is a Bug-type beetle Pokémon that preys on Shelmet. It evolves into Escavalier when traded for a Shelmet, which evolves into Accelgor at the same time.
description.tagline: A snail-eating beetle with a horn like an escargot fork.

description.fun: Escavalier wears the shell it took from a Shelmet as a suit of armour, and its arms end in lances, making it a little jousting knight. It flies at high speed and charges with lances ready, facing opponents bravely even when it's in trouble. It's popular in Galar, where a famous painting shows it duelling Sirfetch'd. Its name mixes 'escargot' with 'cavalier', and it may nod to medieval art of knights battling snails.
description.guide: Escavalier is the evolved form of Karrablast, a Bug- and Steel-type Pokémon that wears a Shelmet's shell as armour and attacks with lance-like arms. It evolves when Karrablast is traded for a Shelmet.
description.tagline: A jousting knight in armour taken from a snail.
